title: DAF-FM detection of nitric oxide in embryonic cortical neurons
protocol: Treat coverslips with 0.1mg/ml poly-D-lysine and 0.01mg/ml laminin.
Leave treated coverslips at 37°C overnight.
Remove coating solution from coverslips the next day.
Dry coverslips thoroughly after removing the coating solution.
Prepare digestion, dissection, and cortex media as described in Reagents.
Place dissection media on ice.
Maintain cortex media at 37°C.
Prepare papain solution by adding 1ml of 20mM cysteine-HCl and 400U papain to 9ml of digestion solution.
Warm the prepared papain solution at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Neutralize papain solution to pH 7.0 using 0.1M NaOH.
Filter sterilize the neutralized papain solution.
Keep the sterilized papain solution at room temperature.
Sacrifice E17 rat according to institutional ethically approved procedures.
Remove uterus and place it in dissection solution on ice immediately after sacrifice.
Isolate individual embryos from the uterus.
Decapitate isolated embryos.
Remove whole brain from decapitated embryos.
Place removed brains in fresh dissection media.
Dissect cortices using a dissection microscope carefully removing meninges.
Collect dissected cortices in a 50ml tube containing ice-cold dissection solution.
Remove dissection solution from the cortices.
Add 10mls of papain solution to cortices.
Incubate cortices with papain solution at 37°C for 25 minutes.
Gently swirl the tubes every 5 minutes during digestion.
Avoid shaking the tubes during the last 5 minutes of digestion.
Remove the papain solution carefully when cortices become 'sticky'.
Add 1 ml of FBS immediately to inhibit any remaining papain.
Wash the cortices by gently adding and removing 10 ml of warm cortical media, repeating four times.
Dissociate the cortices in 10 ml of cortical media by passing through a 10 ml plastic pipette eight times.
Pass the dissociated culture through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Estimate the cell number using a hemocytometer chamber and dilute the culture to 0.5 million cells per ml.
Plate 200,000 cells per coated coverslip in a 4-well plate and place in a cell incubator at 37°C and 10% CO₂.
Starve cells for 16 hours prior to DAF imaging in media containing 3% serum and 50 μM DL-AP5.
Load cells with the probe by replacing media with DMEM containing 1 mM glutamine, 50 μM DL-AP5, and 10 μM DAF-FM-DA, left at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Wash the cells three times using media to remove excess probe.
Replace the cells at 37°C for 15 minutes to allow intracellular de-esterification of the probe.
Treat the cells as desired.
Replace the media with DMEM containing 2.67 ng/ml CellTracker Red CMTPX for 30 minutes.
Wash the cells once in PBS containing Hoescht for 5 minutes.
Wash the cells twice with PBS alone.
Fix the cells in 4% PFA at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Mount the coverslips immediately.
Image the samples within 24 hours using a confocal microscope at an excitation/emission maxima of 495/515 nm.
